The page gives the detailed named permit cohort and separately provides its conflicting New Zealand FAQ wording.

conflicts.explanation: Niue's current named arrival-permit rule limits Portugal to permanent residents; the page says all other travellers require a visitor visa before travel. A Portuguese passport alone cannot be flattened to the unqualified arrival fallback.

Niue's detailed arrival-permit list omits New Zealand, while the same page's FAQ says New Zealand is included and its passport notes distinguish Niuean-origin and resident stickers. The unqualified arrival fallback cannot represent that conflict.

unresolved.reason: The current Niue visitor page names Portugal only as permanent residents for a 30-day visitor permit on arrival and says all other travellers must obtain a visitor visa before travel. Permanent residence is not a passport-code attribute, so no Portugal-wide route is established.

Niue's detailed named arrival-permit list omits New Zealand, but the same page's FAQ says it is included. The page also distinguishes Niueans and descendants through New Zealand-passport exemption stickers and birth-place details. Do not collapse citizenship, origin or residence conditions into one New Zealand-passport visitor rule.
